newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium issues arrest warrant over freezer bodies.
newsitem.headline: Belgium issues arrest warrant over freezer bodies.

text.p: Belgium on Thursday issued an international arrest warrant for a Lebanese man suspected of killing his wife and two other women and hiding their bodies in the freezer of his restaurant.
"An international arrest warrant has been asked for and received," a spokesman for the Brussels prosecutor told Reuters.
The bodies of the women, who have not yet been formally identified, were found on Tuesday by bailiffs coming to remove property from the restaurant, which closed suddenly last month.

Belgian police named the man they were seeking as Ghassan Bou Ziab, aged 41, who was last seen by neighbours in the middle of last month. A spokesman said they were also looking for Bou Ziab's two children, aged ten and six, and his brother.
Police sources said the bodies were probably those of the two mens' wives and a 70-year-old woman who lived in an appartment above the restaurant.
The Baalbeek Restaurant, where the bodies were found, lies in the heart of Brussels diplomatic district and was well known among the international community for its Lebanese cooking.
